items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, we gonna do that too. We’re doing Lieder by Beethoven. “Ich Liebe Dich” and “Adelaide.” We’re doing several songs by Samuel Barber, “Nuvoletta,” “Nocturne,” … “The Pope and His Cat.” I think it’s the pope [“The Monk and his Cat”]. Yeah, it is, you know, songs like that. It is really going to be a really wide variety of stuff.
And this is going to be when?
